changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led Operations Crew proposal from sourced meeting decisions to accepted action status, with an optional operator review.

title: Meeting Decision to Owned Follow-through
description: Turn authorized meeting notes into confirmed, deduplicated actions and a source-observed project status report, with optional leadership review.
setup_prompt: Use Meeting Decision to Owned Follow-through as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing Operations Crews, authorized notes and transcript revision, meeting and project IDs, owner map, task tracker, status policy, review destination, and prior actions. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, exact artifact validators, one manual meeting, and a separate approved task-write route if requested. Show the plan before Builder applies it. Selection does not create tasks, assign people, notify stakeholders, or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Authorized meeting notes or transcript with stable meeting ID and revision
Exact project and milestone IDs, time zone and status policy
Participant map, owner acceptance and decision authority
Current task tracker or export for duplicate and completion checks
Operations or project owner for the first reviewed register and report
Manual-only or reviewed meeting-note event and cadence

pulse_focus.label: Meeting action follow-through
focus_areas: Whether decisions and assignments are explicit and accepted
Whether open actions have current owners and source-observed completion
review_when: A meeting revision changes, an owner accepts an action, a task status changes, or a due date approaches

Project action status with source-observed open, blocked, done or pending state
Optional operations review brief with owner decisions
Manual route evidence, action ledger and activation choice
